About me
FinOpsMap

I'm a FinOps engineer with hands-on experience optimizing cloud costs across AWS and Azure. I built FinOpsMap because comparing cloud pricing shouldn't require opening a dozen browser tabs — it should be instant, visual, and actionable.

This project is free and open-source. If it saves you time or money, consider supporting it.
